title: The Signature Computer Troubleshooting Database — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Signature-created explanations, original exercises, and normalized records developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Common device problems, diagnostic steps, and safe fixes. The Computer Troubleshooting Database documents common device problems as diagnostic trees: symptoms, safe checks in order, the fix for each confirmed cause, and when to stop and get help. Every procedure is limited to safe operations that cannot damage data or hardware. The Signature side adds symptom matchers that narrow the cause from what the student observes.
capabilities: Document problems as ordered diagnostic trees
Limit procedures to safe, non-destructive operations
State clearly when to stop and seek help
Match symptoms to likely causes
Cover common operating systems and devices
